title: The More You Suppress a Thought… The Stronger It Returns 🧠
description:
Have you ever tried not to think about something, only to find it popping back into your mind even more?

This is called the ironic process theory—a fascinating psychological effect where trying to suppress a thought can actually make it stronger.

Your brain keeps checking whether you're thinking about it... which ironically brings the thought back.
